title: Quadtree Tiling
description: Divides the infinite canvas into a quadtree of tiles, loading only the tiles intersecting the viewport. Tiling makes 'infinite' practical: memory holds the visible neighborhood, not the universe.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Level of Detail
description: Renders simplified versions of content when zoomed out - labels instead of paragraphs, icons instead of diagrams - swapping in detail as you zoom. LOD keeps frame rates smooth across enormous zoom ranges.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Pan and Zoom Transforms
description: Maps between world and screen coordinates with an affine transform - scale plus translate - the mathematical heart of every canvas. Correct transforms with float care keep the canvas stable from microscopic to cosmic zoom.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Spatial Indexing
description: Indexes canvas objects in an R-tree or similar so hit-testing and viewport queries stay fast with millions of items. Without a spatial index, every frame would scan everything.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Viewport Culling
description: Skips drawing anything outside the viewport, the single biggest rendering win on large canvases. Culling turns 'millions of objects' from a crisis into a non-issue for the frame budget.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Infinite Grids
description: Renders grid lines procedurally from the transform so the grid extends forever without storage. Procedural grids give users the alignment aid they expect on a canvas with no edges.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Coordinate Systems
description: Defines world, tile, and screen coordinate spaces with exact conversion rules between them. Clean coordinate discipline prevents the off-by-one-tile bugs that plague canvas code.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Annotation Layers
description: Separates annotations - comments, highlights, measurements - into layers above the content that toggle independently. Layered annotations keep feedback organized without touching the underlying work.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Collaborative Cursors
description: Shows each collaborator's cursor and viewport on the shared canvas in real time, giving the sense of working side by side. Presence transforms a lonely canvas into a shared room.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Minimap
description: Renders a tiny overview of the whole canvas with the viewport rectangle, letting users jump anywhere instantly. The minimap is the canvas's 'you are here' map for infinite space.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Offscreen Rendering
description: Renders tiles to offscreen canvases on workers, compositing them on the main thread for butter-smooth panning. Offscreen work keeps the UI thread free for input even during heavy redraws.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Gesture Navigation
description: Maps pinch, pan, and rotate gestures to the canvas transform with inertia and bounds, feeling physical. Good gesture math - with momentum and rubber-banding - is what makes a canvas feel alive.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Snapping
description: Snaps objects and the viewport to grids, guides, and other objects' edges with magnetic thresholds. Snapping turns fiddly pixel-nudging into confident alignment.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Export Regions
description: Exports any rectangular region at any resolution, re-rendering vector content crisply rather than upscaling pixels. Region export is how infinite canvases produce finite deliverables.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Memory Budgets
description: Caps tile cache memory with LRU eviction tuned to navigation patterns, keeping the canvas fast on modest devices. Budgets make infinite canvases viable on phones, not just workstations.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
